def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(v for v in range(10) if any(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid))

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # identify the grid's full horizontal/vertical separators
    sep=next(v for v in range(10) if any(all(x==v for x in row) for row in grid))
    def bands(n, separator):
        out=[]; s=0
        for i in range(n):
            if separator(i):
                if s<i: out.append((s,i))
                s=i+1
        if s<n: out.append((s,n))
        return out
    rs=bands(h,lambda r: all(x==sep for x in grid[r]))
    cs=bands(w,lambda c: all(grid[r][c]==sep for r in range(h)))
    # Output encodes whether each tile has exactly two marked cells.
    marker=next(v for v in range(10) if v!=sep and any(v in row for row in grid))
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c]==marker for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y))==2 else 0 for x,y in cs] for a,b in rs]
PY

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the solid separator color and split into rectangular panels.
    sep = next(v for v in range(10) if any(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid))

    def bands(n, is_separator):
        result = []
        start = 0
        for i in range(n):
            if is_separator(i):
                if start < i:
                    result.append((start, i))
                start = i + 1
        if start < n:
            result.append((start, n))
        return result

    row_bands = bands(h, lambda r: all(x == sep for x in grid[r]))
    col_bands = bands(w, lambda c: all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h)))

    # The least-valued non-separator color is the panel marker; count two
    # occurrences per panel. Use the greatest-valued non-separator as fill.
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep}
    marker = max(colors)
    fill = min(colors)
    return [[
        1 if sum(grid[r][c] == marker
                 for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)) == 2 else fill
        for c0, c1 in col_bands
    ] for r0, r1 in row_bands]
PY
